features: 24X7 ADVANCED HEALTH & SLEEP TRACKING: Monitor your Sleep, Heart Rate, Blood Oxygen levels, HRV, stress, steps and calories with continuous wellness insights powered by an advanced high-precision 4PD sensor.
VOICE RECORDING: Easily capture conversations, meetings and ideas right from your wrist.

AI TRANSCRIPTION & SUMMARIES: Your Qore Vox recognises English, 7 Indian Languages and 24 Foreign Languages and provides AI powered transcripts and summaries - share them or come back to them later when needed.
RECOVERY MODE AND AI POWERED HEALTH INSIGHTS: Every morning you receive a Recovery Score and AI powered Health Report which provides personalised insights and recommendations.
HIGH PRECISION SENSORS: When it comes to health, accuracy matters. Your Qore Vox comes with high-precision 4PD sensors to track heart rate, HRV, blood oxygen, SpO2, stress and sleep accurately.
SLEEP, MOVE, PLAY: Your Qore Vox tracks everything that counts - Steps, Calories, Sleep, and 100+ Sports

PRIVACY BUILT-IN: We take privacy seriously. Your Qore Vox only records when you double-press. People around you can see a visible display light to know that Vox is recording. All recordings, transcripts and summaries stay on your band and phone only.
